# Teen Driving Lessons Learned

Written 2026-03-29, after Maya's license, for when Eli starts. Ten months from permit to license; it took longer and cost more than planned.

## Timing

- We planned 50 hours in 6 months. It took 10 months (2025-05-12 to 2026-03-08). Summer had daylight but no night hours; winter had night hours but weekend ice. Plan on 40 weeks.
- The course in the first summer worked well: Maya had six professional lessons before the hard driving started ([[wrenfield-driving-school-course-outline]]).

## What to practice on purpose

The log by 2025-11 showed 31 hours, almost all on dry residential roads. The last 20 hours were planned against a list: highway merging (5 sessions), rain (3), parking garage (2), the hospital roundabout (2), night on unlit county roads (4). Next time, plan that list from the start ([[supervised-driving-hours]]).

## Records

- Start the log as a shared spreadsheet, not paper ([[supervised-driving-log-paper-2025]], archived; [[supervised-driving-log]]). The paper log got wet once and two entries were unreadable.
- Scan the course certificate the day it arrives; the licensing office wanted it.

## Insurance

- Call [[ansel-duarte]] the day after the test, with the good-student form already signed by the school. The form took a week to get from the office last time.
- Cost: +$1,140 a year for Maya ([[auto-insurance-policy]]). Two teen drivers will be more; ask Ansel for the second-teen figure before Eli's test.

## Car

Learning in the Arden with emergency braking was easier on my nerves than in the van ([[safety-features-before-age-for-teen-cars]]).
